common_interface_contract.axial_contacts: finite owned face intersection, compression only, frictionless; normal gap0 is touch, not pressure. Retain every washer/receiver hole; no disk fill, gap adjustment or ties.
common_interface_contract.washer_moment_rule: M_receiving=M_pressure+(r_pressure-r_receiving) cross F; local-to-world rotate full wrench at each own declared plane, then translate origin. Distributed pressure/moment recovery required.
common_interface_contract.engagement: independent rank-six rigid-motion fits to owned shaft and hollow-nut patches at the common origin; equate three translations and two transverse rotations; use the adjoint for wrench recovery
common_interface_contract.engagement_scope: infinite translational/tilt engagement sensitivity across exclusion gap; no actual helix/flank/thread stiffness, stripping strength, spin-to-axial pitch law, preload or friction
common_interface_contract.shaft_profiles: existing fullD reference and explicit0.8D sensitivities; Lb/Lg are standard metadata, not actual thread-start switches or delivered profile bounds
common_interface_contract.radial_gap_rule: (owned bore diameter - local shaft segment diameter)/2; open clearance before engagement, frictionless normal bearing

checks.check_scope: pure input contracts only; no mesh/contact response is inferred
